title: Excess Flood Policies (Surplus Lines): Holding Policies on Several Homes
content:
A customer may hold any number of **Excess Flood Policies (Surplus Lines)** policies, one for each insured home at a different property address; there is no per-customer cap.

Each policy is rated, billed and settled on its own, and limits are never combined across a customer's policies.

| Question | Answer under this rule |
|---|---|
| How many excess policies may one customer hold? | Any number; no per-customer cap applies. |
| How many per home? | One for each insured home at a different property address. |
| Is a premium, a balance or a claim of one policy ever worked together with another policy's? | No. Each policy is rated, billed and settled on its own. |
| Can the limits of two of a customer's policies be pooled for one loss? | No. Limits are never combined across a customer's policies. |
